bagPolicy.summary: Small bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed, but all bags will be searched prior to entry. No backpacks are permitted.
allowed: Small bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: Outside food, drinks, snacks, or candy
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There are two public parking garages nearby: Spring Cameron Garage is one block away and Town Square Garage is two blocks away. For rates and hours, visit the county website. The Fillmore Silver Spring has partnered with ParkWhiz for easy parking options.

rideshare.note: Have your ride drop you off at the main entrance on Colesville Rd, or on Fenton St between Cameron St and Colesville Rd, since Colesville Rd is busy and may have cars parked in front.

concessions.note: The Fillmore Silver Spring offers a selection of beer, wine, spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages along with food and snacks. The venue is fully cashless, accepting major credit cards for all purchases. Guests can also enjoy pre-show bites in the Vertigo Lounge.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The main entrance is fully accessible, and guest services staff can take you to the elevator on the left side of the main hall, which goes up to the balcony level. All concession and merchandise stands are accessible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. If you leave, you can't get back in without a new ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are mobile only and won't be emailed or printed. The box office at 8656 Colesville Rd, at the front of the venue, opens 2 hours before doors on show days only, and Will Call is there. Bring a photo ID that matches the name on the tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors generally open one hour before the show start time listed on your ticket. Vertigo Lounge guests get early access through a private street-level entrance.
